title: Selected Cosmographies — Structural Exemplars Rather Than Symbol Collection
purpose: Deepen only cosmographies that teach a distinct structural function useful to the Potato House; avoid broad accumulation of mythic entities.
epistemic_rule: Each exemplar remains a tradition-specific cosmology/practice. Project lessons are typed comparisons, not claims of historical identity or universal hidden doctrine.

exemplars.unique_lesson: World Tree as maintained, inhabited and damaged ecology rather than static axis.
deeper_structure: roots connect differentiated regions and wells/springs
creatures inhabit canopy/trunk/roots and can transmit conflict or damage
the tree is continually threatened yet maintained/renewed
wisdom, fate and water are located at root-associated wells
vertical connection coexists with ecological interdependence and vulnerability
potato_use: Tree needs maintenance and can be damaged without ceasing to be the organism
branch inhabitants/agents can affect the health of the whole
Root is not only past; it can host wisdom, fate, nourishment and threats
information transmission can itself be conflict-amplifying
exemplars.boundary: Do not identify Yggdrasil with Tree of Life/Strife; use it as an ecology/maintenance comparator.

exemplars.unique_lesson: Underworld as timed, staged passage whose dangerous sequence culminates in renewal rather than one static lower place.
deeper_structure: Amduat traditions divide the solar/nocturnal journey into twelve hours
the journey contains gates, denizens, hazards and transformations
Re joins with Osiris in the deep night and is reborn at dawn
funerary use extends solar passage as a model of deceased transformation
potato_use: Below can contain ordered phases rather than undifferentiated darkness
Door sequences can be temporal as well as spatial
deepest point can be transformation/junction rather than terminal punishment
return at dawn is part of the passage contract
exemplars.boundary: Duat is not the Potatoverse Below or Swamp; the comparison is staged passage/renewal.

exemplars.unique_lesson: Center as structured world-order with concentric and cardinal organization rather than simply a summit.
deeper_structure: Mount Meru/Sumeru forms the central axis of a world-system in Buddhist cosmology
terraces and celestial abodes occupy differentiated heights
continents and mountain/ocean rings are arranged around the center
cardinal direction is part of world organization
potato_use: Mountain can organize surroundings, not merely represent personal ascent
center + concentric rings + cardinal directions is a distinct spatial grammar
a summit may be inhabited/regime-bearing rather than pure abstraction
exemplars.boundary: Buddhist Mount Meru is not the Potato Mountain and is not empirical geography.

exemplars.unique_lesson: Intermediate state as a transition category that need not be a fixed place.
deeper_structure: bardo commonly refers to the intermediate state between death and rebirth
some systems enumerate four or six bardos spanning life, death and rebirth
transition can therefore be modeled as state/context rather than geographic floor
potato_use: supports Door/liminality distinction between terrain and transition-state
encourages route models that specify state conditions rather than forcing every transition onto a vertical map
exemplars.boundary: Bardo is a Tibetan Buddhist doctrinal/practice framework, not a generic synonym for liminality or Potato Door.

synthesis_rules: Use Yggdrasil to deepen Tree ecology/maintenance.
Use Duat to deepen staged passage and return.
Use Meru to deepen centered world-order/cardinal organization.
Use Bardo to deepen transition-state grammar.
Do not add more comparative exemplars unless they teach a structural function not already represented.
